name: AdaptiveAttention

n_kv_heads_options.description: list of candidate KV head counts

reference:
import torch
import math
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, n_heads, n_kv_heads_options):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    B, S, D = x.shape
    head_dim = D // n_heads
    options = tuple(n_kv_heads_options)
    hidden = max(1, D // 4)
    router = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Linear(D, hidden),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Linear(hidden, len(options))
    ).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    attention_layers = []
    for n_kv_heads in options:
        attention_layers.append((
            nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype),
            nn.Linear(D, n_kv_heads * head_dim, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype),
            nn.Linear(D, n_kv_heads * head_dim, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype),
            nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
        ))
    routing_logits = router(x.mean(dim=1))
    selected = F.one_hot(routing_logits.argmax(dim=-1), num_classes=len(attention_layers)).to(dtype=x.dtype)
    candidates = []
    for n_kv_heads, layers in zip(options, attention_layers):
        q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, out_proj = layers
        q = q_proj(x).view(B, S, n_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k_proj(x).view(B, S, n_kv_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v_proj(x).view(B, S, n_kv_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        repeats = n_heads // n_kv_heads
        k = k.repeat_interleave(repeats, dim=1)
        v = v.repeat_interleave(repeats, dim=1)
        scores = torch.matmul(q.float(), k.float().transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(head_dim)
        weights = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
        output = torch.matmul(weights, v.float()).to(dtype=x.dtype)
        output = output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, S, D)
        candidates.append(out_proj(output))
    stacked = torch.stack(candidates, dim=1)
    return (stacked * selected.unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1)
description: Adaptive attention that routes among multiple GQA configurations.
